evidence: The ALD ozone SnO2 thin films deposited above the 200 °C growth temperature had high carrier concentration (3.2 × 1020–1.2 × 1021) and Hall mobility (~32 cm2 V/s). Also, films deposited at 250 °C exhibited a polycrystalline structure and high transmittance (over 80% at 550 nm wavelength).
